tei:div.tei:p: Blessed be the Name of the Master of the world, blessed by Thy crown and Thy place. May Thy favour rest upon Thy people Israel in eternity. Show the salvation of Thy right hand to Thy people in Thy sanctuary, grant us the goodness of Thy light and accept our prayer with compassion; may it be Thy will to grant us a long and happy life and may I be remembered among the righteous so that Thou wilt have compassion on me and guard me and all that belongs to me and to Thy people Israel. Thou dost nourish all and sustain all; it is Thou who dost rule over all, Thou rulest over kings and the kingdom is Thine. I serve the Holy One, blessed be He, bow down before Him and His holy Torah at all times. I do not trust in men, I do not rely on angels, only on the God of heaven. He is the true God and His Torah is truth and His prophets are truth and He does goodness and truth in abundance. On Him do I rely and to His holy, honoured Name do I utter praise. Let it be Thy will to open my heart to the Torah, to grant the requests of my heart and those of the whole people of Israel for the good, for life and for peace.
